parsed.modern: deed by serving himself and his family, but whatever remains is difficult among the affiliates. When they smoke tobacco, the pipe circulates benefiting the one to another. When any one receives a present either of meat or drinks, he divides it faithfully with his companions, even though of inferior rank. But they are much more niggardly of their other effects, and especially of their cattle, and do not willingly give these away except when they hope to receive a futtable return : or if any relation has accidentally suffered the loss of his flocks, he is sure to be most willingly afflicted. Perhaps too it may be related as an article of their hospitality, that they abandon their wives to their friends with the greatest facility, and in general they are very little inclined to jealousy.
